import torch


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    rm_shape = ctx["running_mean__shape"]
    rm_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["running_mean__dtype"])
    rv_shape = ctx["running_var__shape"]
    rv_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["running_var__dtype"])
    return {
        "running_mean": torch.zeros(rm_shape, dtype=rm_dtype, device=device),
        "running_var": torch.ones(rv_shape, dtype=rv_dtype, device=device),
    }


def run_correctness(grad_out, input, weight, running_mean, running_var, save_mean, save_invstd, train, eps, output_mask):
    outputs = torch.ops.aten.native_batch_norm_backward(
        grad_out.float(),
        input.float(),
        weight.float() if weight is not None else None,
        running_mean.float() if running_mean is not None else None,
        running_var.float() if running_var is not None else None,
        save_mean.float() if save_mean is not None else None,
        save_invstd.float() if save_invstd is not None else None,
        train,
        eps,
        output_mask,
    )
    grad_input, grad_weight, grad_bias = outputs
    return (
        grad_input.to(input.dtype) if grad_input is not None else None,
        grad_weight.to(weight.dtype) if grad_weight is not None else None,
        grad_bias.to(grad_out.dtype) if grad_bias is not None else None,
    )


def run(grad_out, input, weight, running_mean, running_var, save_mean, save_invstd, train, eps, output_mask):
    return torch.ops.aten.native_batch_norm_backward(
        grad_out,
        input,
        weight,
        running_mean,
        running_var,
        save_mean,
        save_invstd,
        train,
        eps,
        output_mask,
    )
